VELORA TRAIL X — PRODUCT DATA SHEET (ref. VLR-TRX-2026)

Category            Electric mountain bike, full suspension
Model year          2026
Motor               Mid-drive, 85 Nm peak torque
Battery capacity    720 Wh, removable, key-locked
Charge time         2 h 30 to 80 percent, 4 h 10 to full
Frame               Hydroformed aluminium, internal cable routing
Weight              24.6 kg in size M, including battery
Sizes               S, M, L, XL
Range (claimed)     Up to 120 km in eco mode, 65 km in boost mode
Battery warranty    24 months or 500 charge cycles, whichever comes first
Frame warranty      5 years, original owner
Returns             30 days on bicycles, 14 days on accessories
Delivery (EU)       5 to 7 working days
Price               EUR 3 290 including VAT
Colours             Slate grey, forest green
